key_insight: A physics-informed heating-intensity constraint improves welding-parameter recommendations while enabling controllable strong- and weak-regime parameter combinations.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce trial-intensive parameter design for diverse automotive sheet stacks while improving physical consistency.
method: Map sheet attributes and target nugget size to welding parameters using heterogeneous ensemble learning.
Train with multiple losses that minimize parameter prediction error and heating-intensity deviation.
Adjust heating intensity to generate different welding regimes.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved prediction accuracy in same-vehicle and cross-vehicle evaluations, but provides no dataset sizes or numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Generalization to unseen materials and sheet stacks requires validation before production deployment.
paper_title: Development and optimization of parameter recommendation model for automotive resistance spot welding
